problems.title: Exterior loops invalidate the area-to-local-length estimate
source_locators: Definition of L, C and S, p.6
First display and concluding inference, p.32
hypotheses: Arbitrary exterior boundary loop configuration is allowed
Uniform interior face, independent of loop configuration
V uses global outermost surrounding loop; L is longest bordering loop
problems.decisive_evidence: For finite domain D with M variable edges, boundary is one remote simple loop Gamma surrounding D and bordering none of its faces. Every interior L<=M, but V=Area(Gamma). For any c>0 choose s=c(M+1)^2 and Area(Gamma)>s; displayed inequality becomes 1<=0 for every interior configuration.
problems.counterevidence: Interpreting V as the outermost loop contained in D removes the example, but changes the printed definition and needs boundary and uniform-tail arguments.
problems.core_dependency: Final conversion from surrounding-loop events to non-uniform-integrability of L in second clause of Corollary1.2.
problems.repair: Define V_D using inclusion-maximal internal loops. Pathwise average 1{V_D>s} <=36c average L1{L>sqrt(s/c)}. Under UI, fixed-r crossings vanish as R grows, with boundary error O(r/k). First clause then gives arbitrarily large r and fixed R with liminf surrounding probability>=1/2. Discard width-R boundary strip O(R/k), choose s_r=|F_Lambda_r|/2, obtain tail lower bound1/(72c), contradicting UI.
problems.repair_status: Affected implication independently proved, conditional on first clause and standard hexagonal geometry; constants deliberately non-optimal.
problems.impact_boundary: Invalid core derivation established. Final corollary and Theorems1â€“3 not refuted. No whole-paper failure claimed.

problems.title: Full-cube bijection has redundant face coordinates
source_locators: Lemma4.5 and deterministic face rule, p.22
hypotheses: Single hexagon domain; fixed empty uncolored loop configuration
Six edge bits and one face bit
n=1, 0<x<1 for full positive edge support
problems.decisive_evidence: Full cube128states maps to64 coherent defect-edge triples, exactly two preimages each. Restriction to face=OR(edge bits) leaves64states and is bijective.
problems.counterevidence: nu is already supported on the admissible face-rule subset, so pushforward law and subsequent coupling survive.
problems.repair: Replace full cube by deterministic-face-rule subset.
problems.impact_boundary: Statement domain corrected; no demonstrated final-theorem failure.

independent_acceptance_check.scope: One focused independent check of existing findings; not a new full-paper review.

problem_checks.disposition: Retain Major for the specific invalid derivation; retain conditional repair and no-false-final-theorem limitation.
problem_checks.independent_reasoning: The p2 law fixes all edges outside D and allows the remote single finite loop. With empty intervening edges, every variable component bordering an interior face uses only the finite set E(D), so L<=M. The global outermost surrounding loop in the p31 definition is the remote Gamma for every interior configuration. Choosing s=c(M+1)^2 and Area(Gamma)>s gives left probability1 and right expectation0 in the p32 display for any fixed c>0. This is independent of the illustrative finite enumeration.
problem_checks.repair_verification: For inclusion-maximal loops contained in D, their interiors are disjoint. Each length l loop has at least l/6 interior bordering faces, each such face contributes L>=l, and each face is incident to at most six loops. Hence36c is a valid overestimate in the localized bound. Under hypothetical UI, fixed-r crossings have probability tending to0 with R apart from an O(r/k) root boundary strip. The first corollary clause then supplies surrounding probability at least1/2 for arbitrarily large r and fixed corresponding R. Removing an O(R/k) strip and taking s_r=|F_Lambda_r|/2 yields the uniform tail lower bound1/(72c), contradicting UI. The positive lower bound must be uniform in r, as the report explicitly requires.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_impact: Restricting V to internal loops changes the printed global definition and needs the boundary/uniform-tail repair. The corollary itself is not disproved. The Major label follows the demonstrated invalid decisive derivation for its non-UI clause, not a claim that all main theorems fail.

problem_checks.independent_reasoning: The p22 map projects away face bits. For an empty single-hexagon configuration, its full domain has six edge coordinates and one face coordinate, hence128states; the projected defect choices have64states. Both values of the unused face bit map to the same triple. The deterministic face=OR(edge) support has64states and removes the redundancy.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_impact: nu is explicitly supported on that deterministic-face-rule subset; therefore the claimed pushforward law and its subsequent use are compatible with the correction. The full-cube bijection statement alone is false.
